title: The Lost Property Office
description: Four recordings about lost things: a desk conversation, a station announcement, a phone call and a talk about how the office works.
instructions: Read the questions for each part first. Then press Play and listen. Choose the best answer (A, B or C) for each question.

parts.title: Part 1 · At the desk
parts.intro: You will hear Mai talking to a man at the lost property office.

script.speaker: Mr Evans
script.text: Good afternoon. How can I help you?

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: Hello. I think I left my bag on the train this morning. It was the half past eight train from Oxford.

script.speaker: Mr Evans
script.text: I'm sorry to hear that. What does it look like?

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: It's a blue backpack, quite small. It has a yellow label with my name on it.

script.speaker: Mr Evans
script.text: And what was inside?

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: My umbrella, a notebook and a purple water bottle. Oh, and my glasses! I can't read the board without them.

script.speaker: Mr Evans
script.text: Hmm, let me look. We have a black backpack and a green one, but no blue one. Wait, here's something. Is this yours?

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: Yes, that's it! Thank goodness. I was so worried, because my keys are in the front pocket.

script.speaker: Mr Evans
script.text: Good. Can you fill in this form, please? And I need to see your identity card.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: Of course. Here you are. Thank you so much for your help.

parts.title: Part 2 · A station announcement
parts.intro: You will hear an announcement at a railway station.

script.speaker: Announcer
script.text: Good morning, passengers. This is an announcement from the Central Station information desk.

script.speaker: Announcer
script.text: A small brown wallet has been found near platform three. If it is yours, please come to the information desk by the main entrance.

script.speaker: Announcer
script.text: We have also found a child's red coat in the waiting room. The coat has a picture of a rabbit on the back.

script.speaker: Announcer
script.text: Please remember that the lost property office is now on the first floor, not next to the café. It is open from nine until half past five.

script.speaker: Announcer
script.text: Finally, the ten fifteen train to Bristol is twenty minutes late. We are very sorry for the delay. Thank you.

parts.title: Part 3 · A phone call
parts.intro: You will hear Nam phoning the lost property office.

script.speaker: Ms Hart
script.text: Lost property office, Ms Hart speaking.

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: Hello. I'm calling about a jacket. I lost it last Friday at the sports centre, and I wonder if someone brought it to you.

script.speaker: Ms Hart
script.text: The sports centre? Hmm, I can check. What colour is it?

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: It's grey, with a white stripe on each arm. It's quite old, and there's a small hole in the pocket.

script.speaker: Ms Hart
script.text: Wait a moment, please. Yes, I think we have it. There's a grey jacket with a hole in the pocket. Is there something in the pocket?

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: Yes, a ticket for the cinema! It's for tomorrow night, so I really need it.

script.speaker: Ms Hart
script.text: Oh, you're lucky. You can collect the jacket today. We're open until five o'clock, but we close for lunch from twelve until one.

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: Great. It's ten o'clock now, so I'll come at about two. Do I have to pay?

script.speaker: Ms Hart
script.text: There's no charge, but please bring something with your name on it.

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: OK, thank you very much. Goodbye!

parts.title: Part 4 · How the office works
parts.intro: You will hear a man talking to students about the lost property office at their school.

script.speaker: Mr Green
script.text: Hello, everyone. I'm Mr Green, and I look after the lost property box at our school. Today I want to talk about it.

script.speaker: Mr Green
script.text: Every week, I find lots of things. Last week, I found six jumpers, three water bottles, and one shoe. Nobody knows who lost the shoe!

script.speaker: Mr Green
script.text: The best way to find your things is to write your name on them. It takes a few seconds, and it saves a lot of time.

script.speaker: Mr Green
script.text: The box is outside my office, next to the library. You can look in it at lunchtime, but please do not take things that are not yours.

script.speaker: Mr Green
script.text: After one month, I give the clothes to a charity shop. I think that's a nice idea, because someone else can use them.

script.speaker: Mr Green
script.text: So, please be careful with your things. And now, who has lost a blue scarf?
